planning: 先抽取资料结构，再规划页面，不先套模板。
图片、产品、价格、适用对象要参与大纲规划，不后贴。
不确定的信息要进入风险或待补齐页，不伪造成确定结论。
oldDeck: Old PPT tasks must first build SlideIR, classify pages, run aesthetic diagnosis, then generate proof slides before full PPTX output.
AI may write structured diagnosis and redesign intent; coordinates, editable text, image placement, and export remain code-controlled.
Preserve critical facts from source decks: names, years, prices, quantities, client labels, risk notes, and delivery assumptions.
If AI JSON or PPTX image parsing fails, fall back to local rule-based diagnosis and text-first editable redesign.
imageToEditable: For scanned/image/PDF-like inputs, create an object-level manifest before PPTX output: text_inventory, visual_inventory, background_strategy, quality_checks, text_boxes, shapes, images, and asset_provenance.
Readable text must become native PPT text boxes; never rely on a full-slide screenshot as the only editable surface.
Full-slide source rasters are allowed only as references or background candidates, and must be flagged for fake-editable QA when text boxes are overlaid.
Small source-derived raster assets are allowed only for non-text visual objects such as icons, logos, product photos, or decorative marks, with provenance recorded.
Each page needs a visual/contact-sheet style QA pass before final acceptance: source comparison, text completeness, image/object coverage, font size calibration, and shape corner checks.
density: 每页只承载一个主信息；长文字先拆页或改写。
cover、quote 不超过 2 条 bullet；closing 不超过 4 条 bullet。
标题优先短句，不靠缩小字号解决拥挤。
rhythm: 5 页以上至少 3 种 layout；8 页以上至少 5 种 layout。
避免连续 3 页使用同一种正文结构。
长 deck 前部可用 toc，中段穿插 section 或 quote 作为呼吸页。
image: 有产品图、包装图或效果图时优先安排 visual 或 product-detail。
截图和信息图优先完整显示；照片和产品图优先保留完整包装。
同组多图保持相同比例、边距和视觉重心。
editing: 保存文字后必须重建 PPTX 和预览图，并给 previewImages 加 mtime 版本号。
直接编辑只改当前页文字，不应意外重排整套 deck。
PNG 预览失败时保留网页兜底预览并显示 previewWarning。
delivery: 导出前检查 previewImages、exportMeta、quality.warnings 和 events。
PPTX 是主交付物；PDF 或 PNG 失败不能阻塞 PPTX 下载。
最终结果要能被用户继续编辑，而不是只做成静态图片。
templateReuse: For uploaded PPTX templates, inspect slide layouts and placeholders before deciding whether to redraw a page.
Prefer used source layouts with title/body/picture placeholders when the planned slide role matches.
If a layout has no usable placeholders, treat it as style evidence only and rebuild editable objects in code.
Record template-profile warnings such as missing layout links, used layouts without placeholders, and noisy layout sets.
